reviews.x: While I was looking for Charcoal toothpaste, I came across these toothbrushes and found them interesting. As my husband was looking forward to change his toothbrush, we decided to purchase this one. Good thing is this is a pack of 4 toothbrushes (including two small ones). The bristles feel good and gentle enough for the mouth. As they are soft and loose, he thought that they might end up in  staying in the mouth but this one did not do so. They clean the mouth perfectly not painful as well. We

BUYER BEWARE!!!! If I could give this NO stars I would. Bought these with NO great expectations thank goodness...just expected a toothbrush that was eco friendly but was hoping for a toothbrush that did NOT feel like Grandpa just whittled it from a stick in the yard...Like those flat wooden spoons from the janky ice cream cups in the 70's ? Bad right??!! ..Worse is that before I used mine, my 3 yo grandson used his....Tore just inside his mouth open, blood dripping down his arm!!!!!!...NOT OK!!

reviews.t: Little bit for the environment, easy switch
reviews.x: When I hear about little things I can do to help the environment I think about switching. Stainless steel straws, bar soaps, etc. This was an easy switch for a great price. It actually helped me out with another problem I have with my daughters which is colored toothbrushes. They always fight over the color they get or forget what color they are. With these I simply used a sharpee to write their name in whatever color they chose. Also 4 brushes for $8 is awesome!

reviews.t: Mold in my baby toothbrush.. not safe.
reviews.x: Black mold appears in my daughters toothbrush. She is only 2 years so I think is not safe for her, maybe not safe for children.

reviews.t: All in all everyone is pleased, including my husband who often rolls his eyes ...
reviews.x: I switched from plastic tooth brushes to bamboo to be more environmentally friendly. This was my first set of bamboo brushes. My husband took the one with black bristles and I gave my two-year-old son the child toothbrush. All in all everyone is pleased, including my husband who often rolls his eyes at my eco-friendly swaps. My only issues is that the bristles seem to fall out occasionally. Since this is my first bamboo toothbrush I am not sure if it is common with bamboo alternatives or if it i

The wood to my toothbrushes splintered and went into my mouth while brushing my teeth! This happened twice and now I am throwing it out. I currently have a wood splinter in the back of my mouth that I don’t know how I’m going to get out. I have used wood toothbrushes before and have never had this problem.

reviews.t: My family loves it, but it does feel different from conventional toothbrushes.
reviews.x: I am so in love with these toothbrushes. My self, my husband, 4-year-old daughter & 1-year-old daughter have been using them for about a week. I like that the bristles aren't too soft, but I have read before that you want to have softer toothbrushes so my preference might not be what is recommended. They are very straight compared to the usual toothbrush and that takes some getting used to. It just feels different to have wood in your mouth than the plastic I have spent decades using, which make

I love these. I love having multiple and not feeling the guilt of a plastic one. I have sensitive teeth and gums, and I've tried other bamboo toothbrushes before but this one feels much better than those. It's soft but still firm enough to feel clean. Doesn't hurt my teeth after unlike a lot of toothbrushes. As for those wondering, no it doesn't turn your teeth black!
I’m not gonna lie, I was very worried (my family is trying to use as less plastic as possible), but they are actually very good !!!
Bristles started coming out after about 3 days.

reviews.t: cut my lips and inside of my mouth
reviews.x: These toothbrushes arrived today, and I was genuinely really excited about them. When I opened the package, they looked great! But then I brushed my teeth...and when I spit out my toothpaste I noticed I spit blood, then it got worse and that was all I was spitting out. I held gauze to my lips for over 30 minutes and when the bleeding finally stopped, the cuts burned. Looks like vaseline will be my best friend the next couple days!

As a family we made the decision to switch from plastic toothbrushes to a eco-friendly toothbrush. I am super happy with our choice. The transition was easy. These are great and I have no complaints at all about them. I wrote each family members name on their brush with permanent marker. I may let the children decorate their own next time we order! Highly recommend making the switch!

These are terrible. They are cheaply made and the bristles will cut your gums! I do not have sensitive teeth and floss daily. I thought I would give them a few tries in case I just brushed too hard but each time they caused painful cuts on my gums. The box says Made in China. Not sure how “eco-friendly” they really are, but they are definitely not soft and seem to be made with cheap plywood. Save your money and buy quality brushes.

I absolutely love these toothbrushes. I was reading reviews that the bristles fall off easy and that it's too harsh. I personally have not experience either of those. It's definitely more rough for anyone that uses soft toothbrushes but I like to feel like I'm really cleaning my teeth. The shorter toothbrushes are perfect for travel. One toothbrush has now lasted me over a month so I've been pretty happy with it.

I love my toothbrush. I bought the combination package because my 14-month-old grandson sometimes spends the night with me and I wanted him to have a nice toothbrush. So far the toothbrushes have been great and I have not had any of the bristles fall out. I am very pleased with this purchase and I highly recommend. And sewing and expensive. Just buy them for your guests if nothing else!

reviews.t: Super great if you don't want to use plastic
reviews.x: Super great if you don't want to use plastic. I feel like it cleans better than all my old tooth brushes. Mine has been holding up fine, but the bristles on my partner's have been falling out since it's first use.

reviews.t: I got exactly what it looks like in the picture
reviews.x: Packaging was great order was exactly shown as in picture bristles are really soft toothbrushes light weight I love them and definitely will re-order package came on time
Good product is more durable than expected

Toothbrushes are great! The finish on the bamboo comes off when you use it but really makes no difference, just feels a bit dryer in your hand. Been using it for like a month now and no bristles have come loose, no mold (you have to let it air out), and the small ones work great for travel size. Seems unnecessary having 4 small boxes inside a larger box but at least it’s not plastic

Exactly as described! I’m glad I bought these ones compared to other brands I was considering. It’s a great price for 4 toothbrushes. The bristles are soft (but not too soft), and I don’t feel guilty about throwing them out because there’s not plastic made with these. So it will naturally biodegrade.

We love these brushes! The bristles are incredibly soft, which means a little bit of toothpaste foams nicely and goes a long way. The kids liked being able to decorate their handles with marker to make each brush unique.

the design is a new sensation to get used to as the plastic ones were bulkier but once the adjustment period wears off it's like going back to basics. great product. great for traveling and camping. thanks

They’re kind of short but they’re nice. There’s no plastic at all. Which is great! I love the idea of trying to be plastic free. And biodegradable items. They’re also great for children! Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Works well and keeps your teeth clean
reviews.x: A great amount for the price, I’ve been using for months now and I absolutely love these. Also glad to use less plastic. The bristles are soft but hard enough to clean teeth well.
I will keep buying these for myself and my toddlers. They are a good size and get the job done. No issues. I am getting ready to order my second box.

claims.text: Many reviewers are happy with the eco-friendly switch and consider these a good value, easy replacement for plastic toothbrushes.
Several reviewers report safety problems, including bristles cutting gums or lips, wood splinters, and mold.
Some reviewers find the bristles too firm or rough, while others describe them as gentle yet effective for sensitive teeth.
A few reviewers report bristles falling out or the brushes feeling flimsy and cheaply made.
Families appreciate the multi-pack with child-sized brushes, making it easy for everyone to use.
